stories.title: Veja o que fizeram os candidatos ao governo do AM nesta segunda-feira (28)

en.title: See what candidates for Amazonas governor did on Monday (28)
en.summary: Candidates for Amazonas governor conducted campaign activities on September 28, including interior travel, electoral advertising recordings, and television debate participation. The first round of elections is scheduled for October 4.

stories.title: Fux suspende decisão de Dino sobre fake news de Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Fux suspends Dino's decision on fake news about Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: Justice Minister Fux of the Federal Supreme Court suspended a previous decision by Flávio Dino related to content about Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Fux contraria Dino e manda suspender novamente publicações sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Fux contradicts Dino and orders suspension of Nossa Senhora publications again
en.summary: Justice Minister Luiz Fux ordered the suspension of publications about Nossa Senhora Aparecida, contradicting a previous Flávio Dino decision, and requested court plenary analysis.

stories.title: Lula e Janja exploram fake news sobre Nossa Senhora, e presidente ataca igreja por elo com Vorcaro

en.title: Lula and Janja exploit fake news about Nossa Senhora, and president attacks church over Vorcaro link
en.summary: President Lula stated during a campaign event in Pará that no one will disrespect Nossa Senhora Aparecida under his presidency and attacked the Lagoinha Baptist Church. Janja associated the opposition with defending the removal of the saint's status as Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro compara fake news sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida a facada no pai

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro compares fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida to knife attack on his father
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro dismissed as false a claim that he would remove Our Lady of Aparecida's status as Brazil's Patroness, comparing the situation to the 2018 knife attack his father Jair Bolsonaro experienced during elections.

stories.title: Fake news sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida é nova amostra de religião como arma eleitoral

en.title: Fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida is new example of religion as electoral weapon
en.summary: False claims about religious figures and political figures' beliefs circulate during elections, with conspiracy theories alleging Freemasons, Satanists, and church closures across different political candidates.

stories.title: Clubes ameaçam boicote, e reunião com governo Lula sobre bets é cancelada

en.title: Clubs threaten boycott, and meeting with Lula government about bets is cancelled
en.summary: Football clubs coordinated to avoid a government meeting on sports betting prohibition, prompting President Lula's administration to cancel the scheduled encounter.

stories.title: Deputado do PL no Rio ameaça sacar arma contra militantes do PSOL

en.title: PL deputy in Rio threatens to draw weapon against PSOL activists
en.summary: State deputy Alexandre Knoploch threatened to draw a firearm during a confrontation with PSOL activists on Monday morning.

stories.title: 'O que é uma mentira para o filho do pai da mentira?', questiona leitor sobre fake news envolvendo Flávio

en.title: 'What is a lie for the son of the father of lies?', reader questions regarding fake news involving Flávio
en.summary: A reader questions the nature of misinformation in a matter involving Flávio, referencing a philosophical inquiry about deception.

stories.title: Resultado da Quina 7129: confira as dezenas sorteadas nesta segunda-feira (28)

en.title: Quina 7129 Results: check the numbers drawn this Monday (28)
en.summary: The lottery draw for Quina contest 7129 took place on Monday with an estimated prize of R$ 11.5 million.

stories.title: Justiça concede liberdade condicional a Wilker Leão após prisão

en.title: Court grants conditional freedom to Wilker Leão after arrest
en.summary: A Novo party candidate arrested for damaging public property received conditional release from a judge without requiring bail payment.

stories.title: Janja usa medalha de Nossa Senhora Aparecida após fake news sobre padroeira

en.title: Janja wears Our Lady of Aparecida medal after fake news about patron saint
en.summary: Janja wore a medal of Our Lady of Aparecida in response to misinformation circulating about Brazil's patron saint.

stories.title: CEO da Nidec deve renunciar devido a prejuízos em unidade de sistemas para veículos elétricos

en.title: CEO of Nidec to resign due to losses in electric vehicle systems unit
en.summary: Mitsuya Kishida, 66-year-old chief executive of Japanese electric motor manufacturer Nidec, is stepping down following significant impairment losses and accounting irregularities in the electric vehicle business division.

stories.title: TSMC planeja 2ª fábrica em Cingapura após produção da 1ª unidade ser toda reservada

en.title: TSMC plans 2nd factory in Singapore after 1st unit production fully booked
en.summary: TSMC's affiliate VIS inaugurated its first advanced chip factory in Singapore and is already planning a second facility, as the first unit's production is completely reserved due to growing artificial intelligence infrastructure demand.

stories.title: Fux acata pedido da defesa de Flávio e cassa decisão de Dino sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Fux upholds defense request by Flávio and overturns Dino's decision on Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: Federal Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux suspended Justice Flávio Dino's decision regarding electoral content removal related to candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and Nossa Senhora Aparecida, with the full court to rule Wednesday.

stories.title: Petróleo sobe com impasse nas negociações de cessar-fogo entre EUA e Irã

en.title: Oil rises amid stalemate in ceasefire negotiations between USA and Iran
en.summary: Oil prices increased as negotiations for a ceasefire between the USA and Iran remain deadlocked, with significant disagreement over terms including reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route for global petroleum.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que escolherá eventual futura equipe ‘melhor’ do que fez seu pai

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he will choose eventual future team 'better' than his father did
en.summary: Liberal Party presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro mentioned potential names for government positions, including economic coordinator Daniella Marques and Senate candidate Guilherme Derrite, suggesting superior choices compared to his father's selections.
